g:HTMLPanel.p: Bootstrap 5.3's link, focus and background utilities, as enums applied with StyleHelper.addEnumStyleName.

d:Example.heading: Link colors and underlines
d:Example.description: `LinkColor` colors a link; `LinkUnderline`, `LinkOffset` and `LinkOpacity` change its underline, including on hover (`*_HOVER`).

d:Example.heading: Icon links and stretched links
d:Example.description: Add `icon-link` (`Styles.ICON_LINK`) to a link with an icon, and `icon-link-hover` to move the icon on hover. `stretched-link` makes a link cover its card.

d:Example.heading: Focus rings and text backgrounds
d:Example.description: `focus-ring` (`Styles.FOCUS_RING`) with a `FocusRing` color draws a custom focus ring; tab to the link to see it. `TextBackground` sets a background with a contrasting text color.
